updates.summary: Added lib/demo/widget/demo_home_wallet.dart and region router-home (go_router.dart); re-hashed only the regions/files Task 38 edited (main-params, main-fields, main-router, router-import, router-param, status-demo; demo_app, demo_state, demo_shell_bridge, demo_mode_test, README) after verifying every other recorded hash still matched. Baseline (pre-install) hashes and original texts unchanged.

Client revision (D-A69–D-A79): removed the notification feed from the demo (fixture notifications.json deleted, parser/state/repository/bridge updated), single wallet balance 4,000 fils without hold fields, lifetime delivery statistics (an older completed delivery added), recharge contact fields removed, the active-order scenario now survives demo sign-out to show startup routing. Re-hashed only: lib/demo/demo_app.dart, lib/demo/demo_state.dart, lib/demo/model/demo_fixtures.dart, lib/demo/repo/demo_repositories.dart, lib/demo/widget/demo_shell_bridge.dart, lib/demo/widget/demo_strip.dart, lib/demo/widget/demo_home_wallet.dart, test/demo_mode_test.dart, tool/demo/README.md, assets/demo/fixtures/captain.json, assets/demo/fixtures/home.json, assets/demo/fixtures/order_history.json, assets/demo/fixtures/wallet.json; region(s): router-home. Every other recorded hash still matched (verified by --dry-run). Baseline (pre-install) hashes and original restore texts unchanged; they restore no Notifications provider, five-tab layout, hold field, recharge UI or old palette (the original texts contain only the plain production lines).

Audit remediation (D-A80). R02 made the real shell-scoped WalletCubit the single Home/Wallet balance source, so the demo Home-wallet connector became redundant: deleted lib/demo/widget/demo_home_wallet.dart, removed its router/main hooks and the router-home region (Home is no longer a demo region; nothing is restored there). Re-hashed only: regions main-params, main-fields, main-router (lib/main.dart), router-import, router-param, router-shell (lib/util/routes/go_router.dart; router-shell re-indented under the shell's session BlocListener, so its restore text now carries the new indentation); files lib/demo/demo_app.dart and tool/demo/README.md. R00 added the narrow sha-pinned historical-audit classification to remove_demo.dart (retained file, unhashed). Every other recorded hash still matched (verified by --dry-run). Baseline (pre-install) hashes unchanged; installed_sha256 is the historical install record and was not rewritten.

Added DemoOrderWorkflowRepository and the demo server's PIN/start/complete/outcome simulation (one completion = one completed delivery + one commission debit, same key = same receipt), completed-delivery history from order_history.json, fictional pickup points and optional fictional 070 phones in offers.json/current_order.json. Re-hashed only: lib/demo/demo_app.dart, lib/demo/demo_state.dart, lib/demo/model/demo_fixtures.dart, lib/demo/repo/demo_repositories.dart, lib/demo/widget/demo_shell_bridge.dart, test/demo_mode_test.dart, tool/demo/README.md, assets/demo/fixtures/current_order.json, assets/demo/fixtures/offers.json. No marked region changed (main/router regions untouched). Baseline hashes and restore texts unchanged; removal leaves the real stage UI/ports with production not-configured behavior.

Demo carries optional customer name, phone and delivery notes plus the full fee from fixture seeds into the active order, stage transitions and completed history (demo-order-done-1 has fictional details; others have none). Tests updated for the single-action Home card, no Home wallet chip and first-name greeting, and for the owner's demo username in auth.json. Re-hashed only: lib/demo/demo_state.dart, lib/demo/model/demo_fixtures.dart, test/demo_mode_test.dart, assets/demo/fixtures/offers.json, assets/demo/fixtures/order_history.json. assets/demo/fixtures/auth.json was changed by the owner and is deliberately NOT re-hashed (it is archived before deletion). No marked region changed.

Sheet decline removed (demo tests decline through the kept PendingOffersCubit.decline). Profile: captain.json gained a fictional phone and a fictional 5-star rating (4.3, 27 ratings); DemoCaptainAccountRepository serves that rating unchanged (validated by the real GetCaptainRating) and reports account deletion as not configured (no fake deletion). English: app_en.arb (a production file, not created by the demo) carries English demo keys at its end, removed by the new exact edit arb-en-demo-keys; app_localizations_en.dart added to regenerated. Re-hashed only: lib/demo/demo_app.dart, lib/demo/demo_state.dart, lib/demo/model/demo_fixtures.dart, lib/demo/repo/demo_repositories.dart, test/demo_mode_test.dart, assets/demo/fixtures/captain.json. assets/demo/fixtures/auth.json still deliberately not re-hashed (owner change). No marked region changed; tool/demo/README.md not edited (Markdown excluded by this task).

signIn in test/demo_mode_test.dart now uses the shared tapLoginSubmit (closes a covering error toast, asserts the button is hit-testable). Re-hashed only: test/demo_mode_test.dart. No region, fixture or demo source changed.

Pickup verification codes removed: the demo server confirms pickup without a code (assignment and pickup-leg checks kept; attempt counter and lockout removed); current_order.json no longer has pickup_pin/demo_pin_only; demo tests updated. Re-hashed only: lib/demo/demo_state.dart, lib/demo/model/demo_fixtures.dart, lib/demo/repo/demo_repositories.dart, test/demo_mode_test.dart, assets/demo/fixtures/current_order.json. tool/demo/README.md still mentions the demo PIN and was not edited (Markdown excluded by this task). No marked region changed.
